facts.statement: The app must not store raw card data itself; card payment must use tokenization or a PCI DSS-scoped hosted field/SDK so cardholder data never touches the app's own servers.
facts.source_title: PCI DSS Compliance for Mobile Payment Apps

facts.statement: Card data must never be logged, cached, or written to crash/debug logs by the application.
facts.source_title: PCI DSS Compliance for Mobile Payment Apps

facts.statement: Accounts with elevated privileges (manager/admin roles) must require multi-factor authentication.
facts.source_title: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Sets New Baseline For Cardholder Data Security

facts.statement: For a restaurant chain with 20 or more locations, major food allergens must be clearly disclosed per menu item, either directly on the menu or in a digital format, by 1 July 2026 (California's Allergen Disclosure for Dining Experiences Act).
facts.source_title: California restaurant menus are facing a big change about disclosing food allergens

facts.statement: Allergen disclosure must cover, at minimum, the 'Big Nine' allergens: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame.
facts.source_title: Food Allergies: The Big 9 — Food Safety and Inspection Service

facts.statement: The customer-facing app should conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA, matching the accessibility bar 2026 U.S. federal and state digital-accessibility rules are converging on.
facts.source_title: WCAG 2.2 Accessibility Standards: Complete 2026 Compliance Guide

facts.statement: Collecting customer data for a loyalty/rewards program requires freely-given, specific, informed opt-in consent (GDPR), and clear disclosure of the program's material terms when a financial incentive is tied to that data (CCPA).
facts.source_title: GDPR and CCPA in Loyalty Programs [2025 Update]

facts.statement: Customers must be able to access and request deletion of the personal data the app has collected about them (GDPR right of access/erasure; CCPA right to delete).
facts.source_title: GDPR and CCPA in Loyalty Programs [2025 Update]

facts.statement: GDPR non-compliance risk should be recorded explicitly: fines can reach €20 million or 4% of global annual turnover, whichever is higher.
facts.source_title: GDPR and CCPA in Loyalty Programs [2025 Update]
